component.name: Carventory
component.summary: Browse a local vehicle inventory in the terminal

description.p: Carventory is an offline, terminal-based inventory browser for items stored in a vehicle. It displays a source-defined list and can optionally display a separate local private inventory file.

Its backup function encrypts changed source files when sufficient storage is available. Backups use a passphrase embedded in the published source code and must not be relied on for strong confidentiality.
